title: Document ingestion and retrieval
intent: Parse supported office/PDF/spreadsheet formats, persist document/chunk relations and expose authorized top-k retrieval with explicit readiness states.

requirements.title: Document ingestion and RAG
requirements.description: Consume the accepted file contract, parse docx/doc/PDF/xlsx with bounded failure behavior, embed chunks and expose admin ingestion plus authorized top-k retrieval.

constraints: Stage 6 file contract is the only file semantic source.
Admin-only ingestion and chat-scoped retrieval are server-side.
`.doc` conversion has a hard timeout and explicit failed state.
No OCR, cloud fallback or production deployment.
